C08-M10-L06-F1.title: Hunt record sections and common omissions
C08-M10-L06-F1.caption: Planning sections constrain what the execution sections test, and conclusion sections make the hunt usable by other teams.
C08-M10-L06-F1.alt: A table with three columns: section, must contain, and common omission. Planning sections are trigger, hypothesis, scope and data coverage. Execution sections are queries and results, where the usual omissions are paraphrasing queries instead of copying them and leaving out unmatched or unresolved rows. Conclusion sections are analysis, outcome, limitations and handoffs, where the usual omissions are unlabeled claims, a missing confidence level, unstated data gaps and a single handoff that is not tailored to each audience.
rows: Coverage stated as yes or no
